PlanDrag captures initial scene and positive finite pointsPerMeter. Bounds/center fit uses the captured scene during drag. dragLight computes source.x + cumulative width/scale and source.z + cumulative height/scale consistently with point()'s positive screen-Y/positive-Z projection, preserves source.y, clamps Position.coordinateRange, and validates the final position.

Marker drag uses .global translation, stable marker identity and captured change/completion callbacks. The terminal translation publishes before finishDrag. GestureState reset, loss of dragging/enabled state and disappearance invoke idempotent completion; marker ownership clears before calling the parent. Parent completion qualifies the light and generation before ending the owned history transaction and clearing PlanDrag. Lifecycle/mode/selection force-close paths are present.

StudioSliderEditing begins before first nontrivial finite write. Shared SceneEditHistory coalesces repeated begins from one owner, commits the preceding owner when another begins, ignores unmatched late ends, and preserves redo for unchanged edits. Accessibility adjustments finish as discrete commands. Native slider forwards final value before completion and ignores value events outside tracking.

Reviewed authored checks for early first-write ordering, repeated begins, cancellation, separate accessibility steps, late other-owner ends, exact precision edits after a gesture, and one-step width undo/redo/relaunch. None was executed by this worker.
